purpose: Teach: 西海岸/ルパン/カンヌ/トロント/スリランカ/レバノン/マニラ/江戸川

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアメリカ西海岸のお話して下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was telling me about his trip to the California coast.
lines.style: Warm, gentle introduction. Soft opening. Slow pace, giving Sho room to absorb. The tone of someone who notices something the child wants to say.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとルパン三世観たいよ
lines.en: Mei-san, I want to watch Lupin III with Dad instead.
lines.style: Quiet but clear desire. Not a complaint—a small preference stated with the certainty only a child has. Quick on the important words, with a slight hopeful lilt at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがカンヌ映画祭の作品を観せて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to show you a film from the Cannes Film Festival.
lines.style: Gentle redirection, not dismissal. Speaking slowly as though Sho might not have heard the first time. Warm and patient, like she's already thinking of what Sho's dad might choose.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとトロントの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-san, I already looked at a picture book about Toronto with Dad.
lines.style: Soft pride in the statement. Not boasting—stating a fact he's pleased about. Slight quickening on 'already,' eager to share that this has happened.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがスリランカの紅茶を取り寄せて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad had Sri Lankan tea specially ordered for you.
lines.style: Pleased on his behalf. Thoughtful tone—she's noticing the care in the gesture. Slight emphasis on 'specially,' like she's inviting him to see how much his dad thinks of him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとレバノン料理屋さん行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-san, Dad took me to a Lebanese restaurant.
lines.style: Simple, genuine report of something good that happened. Quick, bright delivery. The contentment of a small adventure completed. No need for elaboration.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがマニラに出張されるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad has a business trip to Manila coming up.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but soft. Not apologetic—just telling him. Pause before 'Manila,' as though checking his face to see if he already knew.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと江戸川の花火大会行きたいよ
lines.en: Mei-san, I want to go to the Edogawa fireworks festival with Dad.
lines.style: Hopeful, almost wistful. Clear statement of wanting something. The opening word quick and eager, trailing off slightly at the end like a question—will this happen too?
